entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State where no 5GMM context has been established or the 5GMM context is marked as deregistered. The UE is deregistered in this state.

entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Registration procedure initiated by the UE that the network may answer to when UE is in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: De-registration procedure
entities.description: De-registration procedure initiated by the UE that the network may answer to when UE is in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: No 5GMM context established
entities.description: Property indicating that no 5GMM context has been established or the context is marked as deregistered.

entities.name: UE is deregistered
entities.description: Property indicating that the UE is in a deregistered state with the network.

relations.description: The 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state establishes that no 5GMM context is established or the context is marked as deregistered.
The 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state establishes that the UE is deregistered.
The initial registration procedure requires the UE to be in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for network response.
The de-registration procedure requires the UE to be in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for network response.
